page_title: LIV 3-0 NOT | Liverpool v Nottingham Forest 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Chris Kavanagh has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Liverpool due to an offside in the build-up play.
90+4' Wait! Referee Chris Kavanagh has indicated he is going to review the Liverpool goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90+3' Goal! Harvey Elliott feeds Cody Gakpo (Liverpool), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 3:0.
90+3' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90' Neco Williams (Nottingham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

90' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alisson comes off the line to clear the ball away. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
89' It will be a substitution. Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is ready to enter the pitch as Trent Alexander-Arnold walks off.
88' Neco Williams beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Anthony Elanga (Nottingham), who smashes a first-time shot high over the bar.
87' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
87' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Good work from Nottingham as they win a corner.
86' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) wastes a huge chance as he sends a first-time shot from the goal area straight onto the crossbar!
83' Substitution. Morgan Gibbs-White is replaced by Neco Williams (Nottingham).
83' Here is a change. Orel Mangala is going off and Steven Cooper gives the last tactical orders to Andrey Santos (Nottingham).
82' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
80' Substitution. Wataru Endo (Liverpool) in, Darwin Nunez out.
77' 3 - 0 Goal! Matt Turner makes a huge mistake and Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 3:0.

75' Liverpool slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
72' The ball possession is 75:25.
69' Today's match ends for Willy Boly who will be replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
69' Substitution. Ola Aina makes way for Harry Toffolo (Nottingham).
69' Steven Cooper has decided to make a change. Ryan Yates (Nottingham) replaces Nicolas Dominguez.
66' A rebound falls kindly for Harvey Elliott (Liverpool), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
66' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
66' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Liverpool.
64' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot high over the bar.
63' Murillo (Nottingham) is penalised for holding. Chris Kavanagh signals a set piece. Liverpool earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
60' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

59' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
59' Jurgen Klopp has decided to substitute Ryan Gravenberch and he is replaced by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool).
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Diogo Jota departs the field of play to be replaced by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
58' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.

55' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.

54' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Liverpool are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
52' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
48' A long pass finds Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
46' Referee Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
45+4' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool). The ball is out of play and Liverpool manage to earn a corner.
45+3' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) was too forceful with his tackle and Chris Kavanagh interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Liverpool have been awarded a free kick.
45+2' Serge Aurier (Nottingham) attempts to find Anthony Elanga, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' The resulting corner, taken by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham), comes to nothing.
43' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Nottingham will take a corner kick.
40' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

40' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.

40' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Matt Turner thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
40' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Matt Turner makes a comfortable save.
39' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
38' Murillo (Nottingham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Liverpool.
35' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Dominik Szoboszlai sprays a pass out to Darwin Nunez (Liverpool), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:0.
33' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Orel Mangala (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.
31' 1 - 0 Goal! Diogo Jota (Liverpool) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 1:0.

31' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Matt Turner pulls off a brilliant save.
30' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
30' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

29' Matt Turner pulls off a great save to deny Darwin Nunez (Liverpool), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. Corner kick. Liverpool will have an opportunity.
28' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempts to find Ryan Gravenberch with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
26' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
25' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Liverpool force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
24' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
22' The game is interrupted now, Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
21' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes a pot shot from distance after a rebound fell kindly for him, but it's blocked by an opponent.
21' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) takes the corner but it's cleared.

21' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Liverpool force their opponents to concede a corner.
19' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
16' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) swings it in and Diogo Jota gets on the end of it, but Matt Turner shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
15' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.
12' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
9' The game is interrupted as Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is flagged offside.
8' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
8' There's an opportunity for Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
8' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Now Liverpool have a corner.
7' Liverpool are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
5' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
4' A spell of possession for Liverpool in an attempt to control the game.

Liverpool will kick-off.
